subject: [AMBER] Force filed for non-specific residue CAS

messages.author: Jelena Tosovic
messages.body:
Hello,
I would like to run MD simulation for the protein system which
consists non-specific residue CAS (S-(DIMETHYLARSENIC)CYSTEINE).  tLeap
doesn't recognise this amino acid residue.Where can I find the designation
for CAS amino acid which tLeap will recognize?
Best regards,
Jelena

messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
S-(dimethylarsenic)cysteine is a non-standard (not “non-specific”) amino acid. Your choice is to either find parameters in the literature or to develop parameters yourself. Googling "AMBER, parameterize non-standard residue” returns some great references for a starting place.
I hope that helps.
Best,
Matthew
